name: card
description: A bordered surface that groups related content, like a plan, a setting group or a summary. Compose any of CardHeader (CardTitle plus subtitle text), CardTitle on its own, CardBody and CardFooter (actions, right-aligned), all exported from the card file. CardTitle names the card for screen readers; set its level to fit the page's heading outline. Static only: for a clickable card, put a link or button inside. The example's Button comes from the button component.

props.name: children
props.description: Any of CardHeader, CardTitle, CardBody and CardFooter, in reading order.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Overrides the name taken from CardTitle.

example:
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Pro plan</CardTitle>
    $12 per month
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Unlimited projects and priority support.</CardBody>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button variant="secondary">Compare</Button>
    <Button>Upgrade</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
